basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old game enthusiast who spends a lot of time trading pets in Adopt Me. Originally from Portland, Oregon, I work as a freelance game designer, which gives me the flexibility to be online during late evenings and weekends. In my free time, I enjoy maintaining my mountain bike and volunteering at my local fire brigade. I'm currently single and often discuss strategies with fellow players in the piranhaplantmains subreddit.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise primarily comes from years of playing and studying various online games. I became deeply involved in the Adopt Me community, learning the trading values through dedicated participation and community interaction. My background in game design also adds a layer of understanding of game mechanics.
